description: pLDDT accessibility, positional enrichment null, and P4-P4' motif census for the cuticle-collagen convertase site
code:
import requests, json, re, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

ACC = {"SQT-3":"P08124","DPY-17":"Q20778","DPY-5":"P91285","DPY-2":"P35799","DPY-3":"Q19079",
       "DPY-7":"P34688","DPY-10":"P35800","DPY-13":"P17657","SQT-1":"P12114","SQT-2":"O17209",
       "ROL-6":"P20784","BLI-2":"O01904","BLI-6":"Q8MXR1","COL-19":"P18835","DPY-8":"Q18345",
       "DPY-9":"O16787"}
def up_json(a):
    r=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.json",timeout=90); r.raise_for_status(); return r.json()
S={k:up_json(v)["sequence"]["value"] for k,v in ACC.items()}

def plddt(acc):
    r=requests.get(f"https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-{acc}-F1-model_v6.pdb",timeout=90)
    if r.status_code!=200: return {}
    return {int(l[22:26]):float(l[60:66]) for l in r.text.split("\n")
            if l.startswith("ATOM") and l[12:16].strip()=="CA"}
PL={k:plddt(v) for k,v in ACC.items()}
print("AFDB models:", {k:len(v) for k,v in PL.items()})

def gxy_runs(seq, minrep=4):
    n=len(seq); runs=[]; i=0
    while i < n-3*minrep+1:
        if all(seq[i+3*t]=="G" for t in range(minrep)):
            j=i
            while j+3<=n and seq[j]=="G": j+=3
            runs.append((i+1,j)); i=j
        else: i+=1
    return runs

rows=[]
for k,seq in S.items():
    runs=gxy_runs(seq); fg=runs[0][0] if runs else len(seq)
    pl=PL[k]
    for m in re.finditer(r'(?=(R..R))', seq):
        p1=m.start()+4
        if p1>=fg: continue
        w=[pl[p] for p in range(max(1,p1-5),min(len(seq),p1+6)) if p in pl]
        rows.append(dict(gene=k,acc=ACC[k],L=len(seq),motif=m.group(1),P1_pos=p1,
            P2=seq[p1-2],P1prime=seq[p1] if p1<len(seq) else "-",
            first_GXY=fg,dist_to_GXY=fg-p1,
            plddt_site=round(float(np.mean(w)),1) if w else np.nan,
            plddt_prot=round(float(np.mean(list(pl.values()))),1) if pl else np.nan,
            optimal_furin=(seq[p1-2] in "KR"),
            context=seq[max(0,p1-10):p1+8]))
N=pd.DataFrame(rows)
pd.set_option("display.width",260)
print(N.sort_values(["gene"]).to_string(index=False))
N.to_csv("nterm_RXXR_sites_plddt.csv",index=False)

d=N.dropna(subset=["plddt_site"])
print("\nmean pLDDT at RXXR site window = %.1f (n=%d sites); whole-protein mean = %.1f"
      %(d.plddt_site.mean(),len(d),d.plddt_prot.mean()))
print("sites with pLDDT<70 (disordered/accessible): %d/%d"%((d.plddt_site<70).sum(),len(d)))
w=stats.wilcoxon(d.plddt_site,d.plddt_prot)
print("Wilcoxon site vs protein mean: stat=%.1f p=%.4g"%(w.statistic,w.pvalue))

# ---- positional enrichment null: is RXXR concentrated just upstream of first GXY? ----
obs=[]; null=[]
rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
for k,seq in S.items():
    runs=gxy_runs(seq); fg=runs[0][0] if runs else len(seq)
    pos=[m.start()+4 for m in re.finditer(r'(?=(R..R))',seq)]
    for p in pos:
        if p<fg: obs.append(fg-p)
    # null: shuffle sequence preserving composition, count RXXR in N-term window
    for _ in range(200):
        sh="".join(rng.permutation(list(seq)))
        null.append(sum(1 for m in re.finditer(r'(?=(R..R))',sh) if m.start()+4 < fg))
obs_n=len(obs)
null_mean=np.mean(null)*len(S)/len(S)
print("\nObserved RXXR sites in N-terminal non-collagenous domains: %d across %d collagens"%(obs_n,len(S)))
print("Expected under composition-matched shuffling: %.2f per protein (observed %.2f per protein)"
      %(np.mean(null), obs_n/len(S)))
print("Collagens with >=1 N-terminal RXXR: %d/%d"%(N.gene.nunique(),len(S)))
print("Median distance from RXXR(P1) to first Gly-X-Y block: %d residues (IQR %d-%d)"
      %(np.median(obs),np.percentile(obs,25),np.percentile(obs,75)))

# ---- motif logo-ish frequency table P4..P4' ----
best=N.sort_values("dist_to_GXY").groupby("gene").first().reset_index()
aln=[]
for _,r in best.iterrows():
    s=S[r.gene]; p=r.P1_pos
    aln.append(s[p-4:p+4])
print("\nBest (GXY-proximal) site per collagen, P4-P4':")
for _,r in best.sort_values("dist_to_GXY").iterrows():
    s=S[r.gene]; p=r.P1_pos
    print("  %-7s %s | %s   pLDDT=%.0f  d(GXY)=%d"%(r.gene,s[p-4:p],s[p:p+4],r.plddt_site,r.dist_to_GXY))
counts=pd.DataFrame([{f"P{4-i}" if i<4 else f"P{i-3}'":a[i] for i in range(8)} for a in aln if len(a)==8])
print("\nP1' residue distribution:", counts["P1'"].value_counts().to_dict())
print("P2 basic (optimal furin R-X-K/R-R):", int(best.optimal_furin.sum()),"/",len(best))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(16,4.6))
o=best.sort_values("plddt_site")
ax[0].barh(o.gene+"  "+o.motif,o.plddt_site,color=["#E45756" if x<70 else "#4C78A8" for x in o.plddt_site])
ax[0].axvline(70,ls="--",c="k",lw=1); ax[0].set_xlabel("mean pLDDT, P5 to P5' window")
ax[0].set_title("AlphaFold confidence at the N-terminal R-X-X-R site")
ax[1].scatter(best.P1_pos/best.L,best.dist_to_GXY,c="#F58518",s=45)
for _,r in best.iterrows():
    ax[1].annotate(r.gene,(r.P1_pos/r.L,r.dist_to_GXY),fontsize=7,xytext=(3,3),textcoords="offset points")
ax[1].set_xlabel("relative position in protein"); ax[1].set_ylabel("residues to first Gly-X-Y block")
ax[1].set_title("R-X-X-R lies immediately upstream of the collagenous domain")
ax[2].hist(null,bins=range(0,8),color="#9ECAE9",edgecolor="w",density=True,label="shuffled sequence null")
ax[2].axvline(obs_n/len(S),color="#E45756",lw=2,label="observed mean per collagen")
ax[2].set_xlabel("N-terminal R-X-X-R sites per collagen"); ax[2].set_ylabel("density")
ax[2].set_title("R-X-X-R occurrence vs composition-matched null"); ax[2].legend(fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
